workflow.name: Validate PR
verified_steps: Validate settings parameters in real browser

code_observations.observed: The static icon link uses /logo.jpg and contains no /vite.svg reference.
BrowserFavicon reads state.user.professor.contract.logoUrl, resolves it with resolveAssetUrl, updates link[rel~=icon], and restores /logo.jpg when empty.
The authenticated header resolves user.professor.contract.logoUrl through the same resolveAssetUrl utility.
Contract updates, uploads, and removals call refreshAuthenticatedContract, which awaits loadUser and refreshes authenticated context.
BrowserFavicon mounts above App at the root, so direct internal routes and SPA navigation share the same favicon synchronizer.
Focused tests cover static fallback/no Vite reference, company logo, logo change across contexts, logo removal, and missing link creation.

result: All material implementation gates are green on the exact material head; package reconstruction is result-only handoff work.
